Additionally, the skin conductance level is measured at 4.2 microsiemens (uS), which is within the expected range for a relaxed state, indicating no significant stress or anxiety. Given the absence of any reported symptoms, these physiological parameters suggest that the astronaut is currently in good health and performing within normal physiological bounds. It is important to continue monitoring these parameters to ensure sustained stability during the mission.
